items.rationale: The page covers multiple chemotherapy mechanisms. A connected example molecule must not be presented as the identity of the whole subject.

The ancillary records were read but not blanket re-verified. The older paclitaxel spindle/freezing and formulation/premedication text needs product-qualified review; doxorubicin includes universal every-cycle language and fixed-limit shorthand; cyclophosphamide has an unqualified acrolein causal statement; target specificity and clinical inventories keep their older source scope.

items.detail: Nine NCI dictionary responses are client shells, both dated FDA PDF URLs return 404, Schiff has no available abstract, and the IUPAC raw definition attempt returned 403. Raw responses stay private; legal labelled/text alternatives support only the specifically read clauses.

The acrolein causal toxicology and POEMS trial remain at their earlier recorded source depth. Pommier uses a held identity-verified raw capture. Most official reads are targeted sections or paragraphs; no whole-paper/label/chapter claim. Current doxorubicin SPL is not the missing 2019 PDF.

The broad later ovarian wording, microtubule freeze/both-groups-stop-division shorthand, treatment-purpose omission and retained TOP1/cross-resistance comparisons retain their named earlier qualifications. No Guide mutation or blanket source closure.

One Mermaid block read in context but not freshly rendered; no browser, hydration, mobile, measured contrast, accessibility, expert, owner or learner acceptance. Static R01 molecule wording proposal remains unapplied.
All prior cohort source, peer, product, artwork, summary-consumer, schema and integration residuals remain in force, including P37/P44/P51 through P61; this cohort changes none of them.
